The later aggregate operates on copies and cannot repair already uploaded data; reuse the exact policy and require a successful publication guard before segment/aggregate uploads.

Defer, pre-existing: unchanged CreateSkillCorpusResourcePayload joins sorted element strings with a pipe before whole-value canonical escaping, so the two reviewed partitions collide. The public helper has no tracked production call site beyond these tests; fixing its versioned canonical representation needs a separate compatibility decision.

Defer, pre-existing: unchanged ValidateDefaultValueType takes line/column from ApplicationSyntaxReference but passes the root command filePath. A partial member in another syntax tree therefore gets the wrong path; this new single-file fixture does not introduce it.

Patch: absence of Timestamp-based ordering is vacuous for a fixture without Timestamp. Assert its actual declaration-order iteration and compile the valid initial generated output.
